reference_section: Appendix G: Technology Readiness Levels - Level 1 Reference Baseline
verbatim_statement: Basic principles observed and reported. Scientific research begins to be translated into applied R&D. Level 1 certification based purely on published theoretical formulation.

source_authority: Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Technology Readiness Assessment Guide
reference_section: Section 3.2: Technology Concept Formulation Case Study
verbatim_statement: Technology concept and application formulated. Invention begins. Practical applications identified based on analytical formulation. Physical proof of concept absent.

reference_section: Chapter 4: Analytical and Experimental Critical Function Proof of Concept
verbatim_statement: Analytical and experimental critical function and/or characteristic proof of concept. Active R&D initiated with bench-scale laboratory experiments.

reference_section: Section 5: Optical Receiver Laboratory Breadboard Integration
verbatim_statement: Component and/or breadboard validation in laboratory environment. Low-fidelity system integration tested and validated in a laboratory setting.

reference_section: Section 4.5: Environmental Simulation & Thermal Vacuum Validation
verbatim_statement: Component and/or breadboard validation in relevant environment. Tested in a relevant environment under simulated operational thermal vacuum stress.

reference_section: Section 7: Airborne Balloon Platform Flight Demonstration
verbatim_statement: System/subsystem model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment. Engineering prototype demonstrated in a relevant flight environment.

reference_section: Section 8: Tactical UAV Prototype Operational Flight Demonstration
verbatim_statement: System prototype demonstration in an operational environment. Demonstration of an actual system prototype in an operational environment.

source_authority: FAA Technical Center Flight Qualification Report (DOT/FAA/TC-24/18)
reference_section: Section 9: Full System Avionics Qualification and Acceptance Testing
verbatim_statement: Actual system completed and qualified through test and demonstration. System qualified through developmental testing and operational evaluation in final configuration.

source_authority: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory Mission Telemetry Report (JPL-PUB-2024-003)
reference_section: Section 12: Mars Surface Mission Operations and Commercial LiDAR Deployment
verbatim_statement: Actual system proven in operational use through successful mission operations. Technology in continuous, sustained operational service across repeated missions.
